messages:
Priya: Heads-up — seeing a recurring latency spike the last 3 days during 09:00-10:30 PST that ate ~3% of the monthly error budget. Not identical to the big outage but appears periodic and getting worse.
Marco: Yep saw that on the dedicated pool. Pattern looks like KV cache miss storms + short-lived GC pauses on one node group.
Sam: Can you paste the spike timeline? I want to check batching and tail latency correlation.
Priya: https://dash.redwood/internal/slo/latency?range=3d — spikes align with bursty prefix churn, 95->99.9 increases.
Elena: I'll own the dashboard updates: add a per-route 99th percentile, a heatmap by node, and an alert for sustained >250ms for 5m. Will push changes tomorrow EOD.
Sam: Proposal: keep current SLO for now but add a short-term SLA note to customers if sustained regressions. Also add a runbook step to throttle new long-running prefix writes during the window.
Marco: I'll own infra remediation. Plan: 1) pin problematic node group to an older kernel (rollback) 2) apply KV cache size bump and tune eviction policy 3) increase small-batch priority. Target: fixes deployed in 72h.
Priya: Can you add the remediation tasks to the postmortem action tracker and assign owners? We need deadlines and verification steps.
Marco: Added tasks: `infra#1234` (rollback), `infra#1235` (cache bump), `infra#1236` (batch-priority). Verification: sustained 7-day regressions <0.5% error budget burn. ETA 3 days.
analytics-bot: Metric check scheduled: will run `rollup_latency_check` nightly and report delta on /reports/slo-deltas.
Sam: For quick mitigation, can we temporarily widen the SLO window for the heavy prefix route to 300ms 99.9P? That reduces immediate customer alerts but keep overall SLO intact.
Priya: I'd prefer not to change SLO numbers without product sign-off. Instead we should add a transparent note to status page and create a targeted alert suppression during the remediation window.
Elena: Dashboard query I'll add for owners (PromQL):
```
sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/api/generate",le="0.25"}[5m]))
  / sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/api/generate"}[5m]))
```
Then a rolling 1h and 24h comparison panel.
Marco: Quick log snippet where KV misses spike:
```
2026-03-20T09:12:03Z node-3 cache_miss=1420 prefix=0x3f2a
2026-03-20T09:12:05Z gc pause=45ms node=node-3
```
Priya: Ok — owners and timeline documented. Action items recap:
- Marco: infra remediation + verify (72h) `infra#1234-1236`
- Elena: dashboard + alert tuning (24h)
- Sam: runbook throttle + temporary alert suppression plan (48h)
- Priya: status page note + SLA comms (48h)
Everyone: confirm if you need extra hands.
Sam: I might need @Marco for testing throttle config tomorrow morning.
Marco: happy to help, will reserve 09:00-10:30 PST for tests.
infra-bot: deploy started for infra#1234 rollback (job 9982) — ETA 20m :construction:
Priya: Thanks — please update the action tracker when each step completes. We'll reconvene in 4 days for postmortem follow-up and SLO decision (keep/rebaseline). :thumbsup:
